notice: Exact source support and consumer reconciliation, not whole API acceptance. The original parser did not emit the unsupported-String partial specialization at TypeConverter.inl:416-429; its actual compile-time rejection is separately verified without fabricating an original declaration.

scalars.js_contract: Explicit native numeric storage and checked scalar defaults; long widths are native C++ domains, not additional JS storage tags.

characters.js_contract: Direct char/Character conversions remain C++ support; Variant enums use their distinct int64 route and explicit character selectors.

aggregate-copies.js_contract: Typed vector/colour values; integer vectors are conversion destinations, with no invented Variant integer-vector storage.

pointer-string-copies.js_contract: Native pointer copies map to guarded ScriptInterface/opaque owners; strings and aggregate values retain snapshot semantics.

numeric-strings.js_contract: Variant/Property/attribute/event typed numeric destinations preserve native decimal-prefix parsing and checked integer ranges.

bool-char-pointer-strings.js_contract: Bool parsing preserves case and whitespace rules; native-only pointer formatting remains unchanged and JS string consumers reject pointer serialization.

vector-strings.js_contract: Integer-vector prefix mutation and float-component atof semantics; native comma-separated text output.

colour-generic-defaults.js_contract: Empty byte-colour strings preserve defaults; invalid nonempty strings reset to opaque black. Unsupported non-string destinations preserve native initial values and report false.

units.js_contract: Native individual unit suffixes support property serialization; unsupported/composite units preserve the native String default.

transforms.js_contract: Shared native transform identity and replacement serialization.

motion-lists.js_contract: Owned transition/animation snapshots and String append behavior.

effects.js_contract: Native shared declaration identity; JS writes create new snapshots. Empty values and cached append behavior are retained.

stops-shadows.js_contract: Typed premultiplied values, independent list copies, unit filtering and replacement serialization.
